task.title: Confidential treasury diligence
task.objective: Evaluate counterparties for a sensitive treasury action, approve a bounded execution path, settle onchain, and write a durable receipt.

steps.summary: Server-side private evaluation returned ranked candidates and a redacted memo.
Wallet connected on Base Sepolia and bounded execution permission flow completed for the chosen provider path.
Live onchain quote fetched from Uniswap V3 QuoterV2 on Base Sepolia for ETH -> USDC.

artifacts.route: ETH -> USDC via Uniswap V3 Base Sepolia 3000

steps.summary: Execution path wrapped ETH to WETH, approved router allowance, and executed exactInputSingle against the Base Sepolia swap router.
Receipt bundle stored through Lighthouse and anchored to IPFS/Filecoin.

safetyChecks: Frozen task snapshot used after evaluation to prevent drift.
Delegation flow scoped to selected provider and bounded spend cap.
Live execution enabled only for valid direct transfer or swap-router settlement paths.
Receipt writing follows execution and includes durable storage diagnostics.
